name: Chong Hong Construction Co Ltd
summary: Chong Hong Construction Co., Ltd. is engaged in the development, rental, and sale of both residential and commercial properties. The company's business activities are structured into two primary divisions: Building and Construction. Additionally, the firm manages industrial property rentals, undertakes civil engineering and construction endeavors, and holds interests in the general merchandise retail sector. Established in 1973, Chong Hong Construction's main office is situated in Taipei, Taiwan.
